compiled_state.title: As a gov-copy-writer agent, I can query 18F, Federal Plain Language Guidelines, and CDC reading-level guidance from the gov-copy corpus (Enhancement slice)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Populate the gov-copy domain partition with the Enhancement federal-style-canon slice: 18F Plain Language guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines (Plain Writing Act of 2010), and CDC reading-level guidance.

**Why**: SC-8 specifies all six federal-style-canon sources. The Foundation slice (bdb4-3211) ships the three most urgently needed sources for the gov-copy-writer epic. This story completes sc-8 coverage with the remaining three sources once Foundation is in place.

**Scope**:
- IN: gov-copy domain Markdown files for 18F, FPLG, and CDC; stable rule_id, prior_art, precedence per entry; docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registration; licensing confirmation for all three
- OUT: USWDS, GOV.UK, VA.gov entries (covered by Foundation slice)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the gov-copy domain partition contains >=1 schema-valid entry per source for: 18F Plain Language guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines (Plain Writing Act of 2010), and CDC reading-level guidance
  <- Satisfies: sc-8  (completes federal-style-canon coverage with Foundation slice bdb4-3211)

- When this story is complete, each entry carries a stable rule_id, prior_art citation, and precedence field
  <- Satisfies: sc-8

- When this story is complete, licensing is confirmed for all three sources (18F: Creative Commons/public domain, FPLG: public domain, CDC: public domain) and documented in docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml
  <- Satisfies: sc-8  (licensing consideration from adversarial review)

- When this story is complete, docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registers 18F, FPLG, and CDC with required provenance fields
  <- Satisfies: sc-7

- When this story is complete, ref-query.sh gov-copy "reading level" returns >=1 result citing 18F, FPLG, or CDC source
  <- Satisfies: sc-8

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked.
